high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "mallikastomar." The post features a woman standing outdoors at night, leaning against a wooden railing with a lattice design. She has long, dark hair and is wearing a black, asymmetrical dress that is form-fitting and has a high slit on one side. The dress also has ruffled details along the hemline. She is holding a small, dark-colored handbag with a chain strap in her right hand. Her left arm is resting on the railing. The background shows some greenery, including plants and trees, which suggests the location might be a garden
